text:
Type: flatweave cotton area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, contemporary, rustic
Materials: flatwoven cotton
Colors: warm red, coral pink, orange, ivory
Shape: rectangular, horizontal stripes with small geometric diamond motifs, flat thin weave, light visual weight
Feel: warm, lively, relaxed
Goes with: light wood floors, beige sofas, leather and terracotta accents; bohemian or southwestern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Geometric Flatweave Cotton Area Rug, 5' x 8', Red, Orange, Ivory
product.description: This versatile kilim rug is designed for the floor but could also be used as eye-catching wall decor. Varieties of red, orange and ivory hues blend in a cotton flatweave created by artisans with an eye for Southwestern-inspired design. 5' x 8' Low pile is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
